final_text:
The incident is caused by database connection pool exhaustion in payment-service v2, deployed just before the failures started. This leads to db_pool_timeout errors, high checkout error rate (~68%), and high latency (~2.45s). Restarting payment-service v2 did not resolve the issue.

The active version is v2, with v1 available as a previous version. The next step is to rollback payment-service from v2 to v1 to restore service.

I will now write the approval brief for rollback_deployment.
